informationClock.interpretation: Actual source acquisition is an upper bound on availability. Unknown publisher times remain null; market close, collection, cutoff and issuance are distinct.

issuanceMeaning: Actual research generation and immutable preservation; publication or production adoption is established separately

output.bandMeaning: Min/max of declared conditional scenarios; not a prediction interval

cycleComponent.displacementDefinition: Damped deviation of the legacy short-term reference from its endpoint trend, returning to zero at the near-phase endpoint. No new scheduled peaks or troughs are invented afterward.
cycleComponent.weightMeaning: Smooth issuance-inspired multiplier, not an estimated share of price variation. It remains positive after the optional near-phase component has ended; cycleComponentActive and cycleDisplacement identify the actual path contribution.

metadata.representativeRule: One deterministic seeded path; no claim that this is the most likely path.
